001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.bar.events.historian;
002
003import java.util.ArrayList;
004import java.util.List;
005import java.util.Set;
006
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.Global;
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.SectorEntityToken;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.SpecialItemSpecAPI;
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.bar.events.historian.HistorianData.HistorianOffer;
011
012public class SpecialItemOfferCreator extends BlueprintOfferCreator {
013
014        public static int BASE_POINTS = Global.getSettings().getInt("historianSpecialItemBase");
015//      public static Map<String, Integer> POINTS_MAP = new HashMap<String, Integer>();
016//      static {
017//              POINTS_MAP.put(Items.PRISTINE_NANOFORGE, 5);
018//              POINTS_MAP.put(Items.SYNCHROTRON, 5);
019//      }
020        
021        
022        protected int numAccepted = 0;
023        
024        public SpecialItemOfferCreator(float frequency) {
025                super(frequency);
026        }
027        
028        public void notifyAccepted(HistorianOffer offer) {
029                numAccepted++;
030        }
031
032        @Override
033        protected BaseHistorianOfferWithLocation createOffer(SectorEntityToken entity, String data) {
034//              Integer points = POINTS_MAP.get(data);
035//              if (points == null) points = DEFAULT_POINTS;
036                int points = (int)Math.round(BASE_POINTS * Math.pow(2, numAccepted));
037                return new SpecialItemOffer(entity, points, data);
038        }
039
040        @Override
041        protected List<Object> getAllSpecs() {
042                return new ArrayList<Object>(Global.getSettings().getAllSpecialItemSpecs());
043        }
044
045        @Override
046        protected String getAlreadyUsedIdFromOffer(HistorianOffer offer) {
047                if (offer instanceof SpecialItemOffer) {
048                        SpecialItemOffer sio = (SpecialItemOffer) offer;
049                        return sio.getData();
050                }
051                return null;
052        }
053
054        @Override
055        protected String getIdForSpec(Object spec) {
056                return ((SpecialItemSpecAPI) spec).getId();
057        }
058
059        @Override
060        protected Set<String> getTagsForSpec(Object spec) {
061                return ((SpecialItemSpecAPI) spec).getTags();
062        }
063        
064        @Override
065        protected float getRarityForSpec(Object spec) {
066                return ((SpecialItemSpecAPI) spec).getRarity();
067        }
068
069        @Override
070        protected boolean playerKnowsSpecAlready(String id) {
071                return false;
072        }
073
074        protected float getProbabilityRuins() {
075                return 0.67f;
076        }
077        
078        public static String PREFIX = "spec_";
079        @Override
080        public String getOfferId(BaseHistorianOffer offer) {
081                if (offer instanceof SpecialItemOffer) {
082                        return PREFIX + ((SpecialItemOffer)offer).getData();
083                }
084                return null;
085        }
086        
087        @Override
088        public String getBlueprintIdFromOfferId(String offerId) {
089                if (offerId.startsWith(PREFIX)) {
090                        return offerId.replaceAll(PREFIX, "");
091                }
092                return null;
093        }
094
095}
